basis.adp: 2qb (format-matched, for QB accuracy); RB/WR/TE depth backfilled from ppr where the 2qb pool ran out — see each player's adp_source
basis.projected_rank: sum of 2026 weekly projections (Sleeper, undocumented/best-effort), PPR scoring, 18 week(s) found as of generation, ranked OVERALL across all positions by raw points — mechanical fallback for fseRank/espnProjectionRank, not a replacement for them if a licensed source is ever added. No positional-scarcity adjustment: ranks QBs earlier than an analyst big-board would, since raw season points don't reflect that only one QB starts.
basis.team_position_rank: within-2025-team rank by targets (WR) or touches (RB); 1 = clear lead option. QB and TE don't get this — TE's version is DraftLab's failsTargetShareGate against team_target_rank instead.

note: Factor values are format-invariant; only benchmark cohorts vary by scoring format. Check each factor's provenance before use: 'measured' is current, 'stale:team_changed' describes the player's previous offence, 'missing:*' has no value at all. bio.top12_finish_count is a measurement (how many times), not a classification — DraftLab's classifyRb turns it into an archetype (schema_version 2, added for that). projected_rank (schema_version 3) is Sleeper's own undocumented weekly projections summed for the season and ranked within position — an honest mechanical fallback, not a licensed projection.
